mapper.select:
select sum(total_spc) as total_spc, (select count(*) from car where car_stat in (0, 1, 3) ) as parking_car,
sum(total_spc) - ( select count(*) from car where car_stat in (0, 1, 3) ) as available_spc from parking

select floor, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 0) as normal_spc, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 1) as elec_spc, count(*) filter (where spc_type = 2) as dis_spc from space group by floor order by floor asc
select spc_no as "spcNo", floor, spc_type as "spcType", spc_stat as "spcStat" from space order by floor asc, length(spc_no), spc_no asc
